name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: physical_interfaces
desc: List of physical interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].access_vlan
desc: Configured Access Vlan. Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].bandwidth
desc: The bandwidth parameter for a routed interface, port channel, or subinterface. - Range: `0`-`3200000000`

name: physical_interfaces[*].buffer_boost
desc: Disable/enable buffer boost on interface. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].delay
desc: The administrative port delay time. - Range: `1`-`16777215`

name: physical_interfaces[*].dfe_adaptive_tuning
desc: DFE (Decision Feedback Equalizer) Adaptive Tuning. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].dfe_tuning_delay
desc: DFE (Decision Feedback Equalizer) Tuning Delay. - Range: `100`-`10000`

name: physical_interfaces[*].dot1q_ether_type
desc: The administrative port Dot1q ether-type. Dot1q Ether Type configures the TPID value in the VLAN tag field for packets received and sent by the interface. - Range: `1536`-`65535`

name: physical_interfaces[*].equalization_delay
desc: Administrative port equalization delay time. - Range: `0`-`31`

name: physical_interfaces[*].evpn_multihoming_core_tracking
desc: Enabled/Disabled state of Core Tracking. - Choices: `disabled`, `enabled` - Minimum NX-OS version: `10.6(1)`

name: physical_interfaces[*].flow_control_receive
desc: Disable/enable rx flowcontrol block on interface.

name: physical_interfaces[*].flow_control_send
desc: Disable/enable tx flowcontrol block on interface.

name: physical_interfaces[*].gtp_hash_mode
desc: Gtp hash mode ipv4 or ipv6 on interface. - Choices: `disable`, `v4`, `v6`

name: physical_interfaces[*].itu_channel
desc: ITU Channel to support DWDM XCVR. - Range: `1`-`96`

name: physical_interfaces[*].layer3_multicast_receiver_vlan
desc: Set vlan ID used for L3 multicast on this interface. - Range: `0`-`4094`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_debounce_down
desc: Administrative port link debounce interval. - Range: `0`-`20000`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_debounce_up
desc: Link Debounce Interval - LinkUp Event. - Range: `0`-`10000`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_flap_error_disable
desc: Enable/Disable Link Flap Error Config. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_flap_error_max
desc: Max Flaps allowed per time. - Range: `2`-`30`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_flap_error_seconds
desc: Time Allowed for max flaps. - Range: `5`-`420`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_mac_up_timer
desc: Administrative port link mac-up timer. - Range: `0`-`120`

name: physical_interfaces[*].link_max_bring_up_timer
desc: Administrative port link mac-up timer max. - Range: `0`-`120`

name: physical_interfaces[*].load_interval_counter_1
desc: The port load sampling interval 1 at bit-rate and packet-rate statistics. - Range: `5`-`300`

name: physical_interfaces[*].load_interval_counter_2
desc: The port load sampling interval 2 at bit-rate and packet-rate statistics. - Range: `5`-`300`

name: physical_interfaces[*].load_interval_counter_3
desc: The port load sampling interval 3 at bit-rate and packet-rate statistics. - Range: `0`-`300`

name: physical_interfaces[*].mdix
desc: The administrative Mdix mode. The Medium-dependant interface crossover (Mdix) is when the interface automatically detects the required cable connection type (straight through or crossover) and configures the connection appropriately. - Choices: `auto`, `mdi`, `mdi-x`

name: physical_interfaces[*].medium
desc: The administrative port medium type. - Choices: `broadcast`, `p2p`

name: physical_interfaces[*].multisite_interface_tracking
desc: Configure EVPN multisite tracking for DCI/Fabric interface. - Choices: `unknown`, `dci`, `fabric`

name: physical_interfaces[*].native_vlan
desc: Configured Native Vlan. Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].port_type
desc: Type of the port: Fabric vs Leaf. - Choices: `unknown`, `eobc`, `mgmt`, `fab`, `leaf`, `extchhp`, `extchfp`

name: physical_interfaces[*].port_type_external
desc: Identifies if or not the port is a external-facing port. - Choices: `no`, `yes`

name: physical_interfaces[*].port_type_fabric
desc: Identifies if or not the port is a fabric-facing port. - Choices: `no`, `yes`

name: physical_interfaces[*].priority_flow_control_send_tlv
desc: Send_tlv used for sending dcbx pfc tlv when pfc mode is on.

name: physical_interfaces[*].priority_flow_control_watchdog_disable_action
desc: Only generate syslog for stuck queue, no action.

name: physical_interfaces[*].selective_qinq_mappings
desc: List of selective QinQ mappings. - Map key: `outer_vlan_id` - Selective QinQ outer VLAN ID. Possible values are `vlan-XX`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].selective_qinq_outer_vlan_id
desc: Outer VLAN ID for selective QinQ for all VLANs. Possible values are `vlan-XX`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].shut_down_lan
desc: Shut/Unshut all LAN VLANs on interface. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].snmp_trap_state
desc: Administrative port snmp trap state. - Choices: `enable`, `disable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].switchport_block
desc: Disable/enable switchport block on interface. - Choices: `none`, `multicast`, `unicast`

name: physical_interfaces[*].switchport_mac_learn
desc: Disable/enable mac learning on interface. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].switchport_mac_permit
desc: Switchport mac-address permit related configuration. - Choices: `all`, `static-only`

name: physical_interfaces[*].switchport_virtual_ethernet_bridge
desc: Disable/enable switchport virtual ethernet bridge on interface. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: physical_interfaces[*].vlan_mappings
desc: List of VLAN mappings. - Map key: `vlan_id` - VLAN ID to be translated. Possible values are `vlan-XX`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].vlan_mappings[*].inner_vlan_id
desc: Inner VLAN ID. Possible values are `vlan-XX`.

name: physical_interfaces[*].vlan_mappings[*].rx_only
desc: Translate ingress traffic only (`true`) or traffic in both directions (`false`). - Minimum NX-OS version: `10.6(3)`

name: physical_interfaces[*].vlan_mappings[*].translated_vlan_id
desc: Translated VLAN ID. Possible values are `vlan-XX`.
